item.title: commandline: Thinking about the evolution of forward-deployed engineers over the last 24 months
item.description:
The article says rapid AI model development and broader technology maturity are changing what forward-deployed engineering means. It frames the role as evolving over the last 24 months, but provides no operational details in the excerpt.
